references.text: Here is the instruction to make forty silver bases under the planks of the tabernacle, two bases under each plank.
Continuation of the instruction for forty silver bases, two under each of the twenty planks.
Describes eight planks with sixteen silver bases, two bases under each plank.
The instruction regarding the curtain to be hung on four pillars with silver bases.
The execution of the instruction with forty silver bases under the planks, two bases under each plank.
Continuation of the work with forty silver bases for the other planks.
Eight planks with sixteen silver bases, corresponding to the calculation in 38:27.
Four pillars with silver bases for the curtain, as mentioned in 38:27.
Explains the origin of the silver: the ransom money of half a shekel from each person who was counted, which was used for the bases in the sanctuary.
The preceding text describing the total amount of silver (100 talents) collected from the census of the congregation.
